# Groundledger

> Agent skills for Claude Code, Cursor, and Cowork: CLEAR blog publishing, SPARK editorial, SNAP/PULSE social casting, ORBIT discovery, PROBE site SEO, SAFE paid media, Studio Desk, Cue Deck. Grounded writing — no fabricated statistics. Paid observe-only by default.

Formerly Clearcast; renamed to Groundledger. Not affiliated with Clearcast UK or other ClearCast apps.

MIT License. https://github.com/dranshrad/groundledger
Docs: https://dranshrad.github.io/groundledger/
Brand: https://dranshrad.github.io/groundledger/brand.md
